architecturalFindings.dataFetching: Standard Next.js server components pattern with Supabase SSR client for data retrieval.
architecturalFindings.clientComponents: Heavy use of React hooks (useEffect, useState) for interactivity in files like InterviewSession, client admin tables, and dashboard charts.
architecturalFindings.transactions: High-stakes operations (like save-session.ts) use multiple RPC calls or batched updates via Supabase.
